policy: Official alerts are selected source-linked public health notices focused on current event/surveillance context. They are not a complete surveillance dataset and should not be read as a live outbreak map.

alerts.title: Hantavirus cluster linked to cruise ship travel, multi-country
alerts.status: WHO Disease Outbreak News and Director-General briefing update
alerts.summary: WHO reported on 12 May 2026 that the MV Hondius cruise-associated Andes virus cluster had reached eleven reported cases, including three deaths; nine cases were confirmed as Andes virus and two were probable, with all reported cases among passengers or crew on the ship.
alerts.riskLanguage: Event-specific international update. WHO said there was no sign at that point of a larger outbreak, while recommending active monitoring at home or in a specified quarantine facility for 42 days from last exposure. This is not a patient-location dataset, live case tracker, or general local risk map.

alerts.title: Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome alert in the Americas Region
alerts.geography: Americas Region, especially Southern Cone countries
alerts.summary: PAHO/WHO issued an alert after increases in reported hantavirus infections during 2025 in endemic countries of the Americas, particularly the Southern Cone, and urged strengthened surveillance and risk reduction.
alerts.riskLanguage: Regional aggregate context. It should not be read as a neighborhood-level or travel-specific risk prediction.

alerts.title: Canada response to MV Hondius Andes hantavirus event
alerts.agency: Government of Canada / PHAC / Global Affairs Canada
alerts.summary: Canadian federal agencies described coordination for Canadian passengers linked to the MV Hondius Andes hantavirus event, including screening, monitoring, isolation protocols, and a public risk assessment consistent with WHO that the overall risk in Canada remained low.
alerts.riskLanguage: Event-specific official response context. Person-to-person Andes virus transmission is described as rare and requiring close, prolonged contact; this is not a Canada-wide live case counter.

alerts.title: Utah resident passenger linked to MV Hondius response
alerts.agency: Utah Department of Health and Human Services
alerts.geography: Utah, United States / MV Hondius passenger response
alerts.summary: Utah DHHS stated at least one Utah resident was a passenger on the MV Hondius and said this did not increase hantavirus risk to the Utah population while state and federal officials coordinated monitoring.
alerts.riskLanguage: Passenger-response notice only. It does not indicate local spread in Utah or a general Utah risk map.

alerts.title: ECDC cruise ship hantavirus response and passenger guidance updates
alerts.agency: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
alerts.status: Official risk assessment and response updates
alerts.summary: ECDC reported seven symptomatic people and three deaths as of 6 May 2026 in its preliminary MV Hondius risk assessment, and framed all people on the ship as close contacts under the precautionary principle while investigations continued.
alerts.riskLanguage: Preliminary rapid-assessment context for a closed-setting cruise event. It should not be read as a complete European surveillance dataset or live outbreak feed.

alerts.title: Argentina reinforces hantavirus surveillance after MV Hondius cluster
alerts.summary: Argentina’s Ministry of Health said national and jurisdictional epidemiology teams reviewed the MV Hondius outbreak, strengthened surveillance actions, and reported 42 hantavirus cases notified in Argentina so far in 2026 and 101 confirmed notifications since epidemiological week 27 of 2025.
alerts.riskLanguage: National surveillance snapshot and response coordination only. It is not a live Argentina case feed, patient-location map, or local risk prediction.
